item.goblincraft.soda.desc: Sean's own brand. Tastes like a thunderstorm. A full meal and Health Boost for 20 minutes.
item.goblincraft.merch.desc: Official Sean merch. It's black. It does nothing. It's drip. Sean's Security leaves wearers alone.
item.goblincraft.glock.desc: Semi-automatic. Sean says it's for 'weather emergencies'. Uses arrows.
item.goblincraft.restraining_order.desc: Joe has to stay 15 blocks away while you carry this. Void if you hit him. Does not cover the Baby Wars.
item.goblincraft.diddy_oil.desc: Slippery. Speed and Resistance for 5 minutes.
item.goblincraft.sixty_seven.desc: Six. Seven. End-game fists. Sean won't say where he got them.
item.goblincraft.baby_bonnet.desc: Joe's gift to veterans of the Baby Wars. Wear it and his babies treat you as one of their own. Sean's Security does not.
item.goblincraft.orb_of_regret.desc: Above level 40, the Altar of Regret demands one of these, on top of your life.
block.goblincraft.altar_of_regret.desc: Use it to clear your passive web. It kills you, and above level 20 you don't get every point back.
item.goblincraft.altar_of_regret.desc: Use it to clear your passive web. It kills you, and above level 20 you don't get every point back.
item.goblincraft.hideout_bench.desc: Everything within its radius is your hideout: safe from raid rules. Use it to build modules and craft hideout gear.
item.goblincraft.secure_beta.desc: 3x2. Use it to upgrade your secure container. What's inside survives death in raid.
item.goblincraft.secure_gamma.desc: 3x3. Use it to upgrade your secure container. What's inside survives death in raid.
item.goblincraft.secure_kappa.desc: 4x3. Use it to upgrade your secure container. What's inside survives death in raid.
item.goblincraft.bandage.desc: Stops a light bleed. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.goblincraft.tourniquet.desc: Stops any bleed. Arms and legs only. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.goblincraft.splint.desc: Sets a fractured arm or leg. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.goblincraft.painkillers.desc: Hides fracture and destroyed-limb effects for 5 minutes. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.goblincraft.field_kit.desc: Stops a part's bleeds and heals it 30% of max health. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.goblincraft.surgical_kit.desc: Restores a destroyed part, stops its bleeding, sets it and heals it. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
